text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"Berkeley, CA","level":"city","category":"rent_increase_limits","status":"in_force","title":"Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB: coverage and 5% cap on Annual General Adjustment","requirement":"Landlords of fully covered units may raise rent each year only by the Annual General Adjustment (AGA), set by the Rent Board using a Consumer Price Index formula. Measure BB caps the AGA at 5%. The cap does not stop a landlord with banked (unused) AGAs from raising rent above 5% to reach the rent ceiling. Government-owned or -subsidized units (e.g., Section 8, Shelter Plus Care) are now registered as fully or partially covered. Fully covered units have a rent ceiling.
